Name: Adina, Son of Shiza
Summary: Son of Shiza the Reubenite, a captain of the Reubenites, with thirty with him.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 11:42: Son of Shiza the Reubenite, a captain of the Reubenites, with thirty with him.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Adina stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
